note: Golden fixture cho LilyHub (lilyhub.top, site VN bach hop/GL/ABO, React SPA + API PostgREST Supabase). Site NHO: chi 23 truyen doc duoc (latest p1 20 + p2 3, 0 trung lap; completed 20). Truyen mau 1: Ket Hon Kin Sinh Con Cung Cap Tren Bang Son — Cong Tu Hoan, Hoan thanh, 69 chuong; ch.1 106 doan, 11825 ky tu, mo dau 'Giang Duu, nguoi tu bo di! Ta khong the nao ga cho nguoi duoc!' / Tan Minh Nguyet huy hon; ch.69 (cuoi) 148 doan, ket 'cam giac hanh phuc vo cung!'. Truyen mau 2: Alpha o re hao mon, phat hien vo la bach nguyet quang moi tinh dau — Duyet Chu, Hoan thanh, 15 chuong; ch.1 132 doan, mo dau 'Lam Nhiem dung truoc cua biet thu nha ho Tham...'. Tim kiem bo dau + khong phan biet hoa/thuong: 'duyen' ra CO DUYEN THIEN HA (1), 'ket hon' ra 3. API: db.lilyhub.top (proxy chinh thuc, dung truoc) chay tot tren may that; tu VM (IP datacenter) ca 2 API host deu treo o buoc TLS (0 byte/timeout) — chi test tren may moi ket luan duoc. Chuong VIP hien khong co tren site nen khong co case VIP trong test.json — chap.js/toc.js van bao loi tieng Viet neu gap. So truyen doc duoc it (23) nen test.json khang dinh minItems tuyet doi cho toc (69/15) va gen p1/p2 (20/3).
